'''Flavin Hold''' was a location on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vindalia]]. The [[Vindalian]] [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Vlaçan Umber]] was from Flavin Hold. The baron mentioned Flavin Hold when introducing himself to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]]<ref name="C" /> around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]'', including Flavin Hold's introduction, to around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Flavin Hold was mentioned in ''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]'', a [[2008]] novel authored by [[Michael Reaves]] as the second installment in the ''[[Star Wars: Coruscant Nights]]'' trilogy.<ref name="C" />
